item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #MINPRSD
Issued at 09:10 PM 15 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #SurigaoDelSur(Lingig), #AgusanDelSur(Prosperidad, SanFrancisco, Rosario, Bunawan, Trento, Talacogon, LaPaz, Loreto, Veruela, SantaJosefa, SanLuis), #Bukidnon(Libona, Malitbog, ImpasugOng, CityOfMalaybalay, Cabanglasan, ManoloFortich), #LanaoDelNorte(Kolambugan, Maigo, Bacolod, Kauswagan, Linamon, SultanNagaDimaporo), #ZamboangaSibugay(Buug), #ZamboangaDelSur(Bayog, Lakewood, Dumingag, Mahayag, Molave, Josefina, Kumalarang, PagadianCity, Dumalinao, Tigbao, Labangan, Tukuran), #ZamboangaDelNorte(SergioOsmeñaSr.), #DavaoDeOro(Laak, Monkayo), #DavaoOriental(Boston), #MisamisOccidental(DonVictorianoChiongbian, Jimenez, Sinacaban, Tudela, Clarin), #LanaoDelSur(Picong), #MisamisOriental(Villanueva, Jasaan, Claveria), #Camiguin(Guinsiliban, Catarman and Sagay) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #SurigaoDelSur(Hinatuan, Tagbina, Barobo, CityOfBislig), #MisamisOriental(CagayanDeOroCity, Balingasag, Tagoloan), #LanaoDelNorte(IliganCity, Tagoloan, Baloi, Matungao) and #Bukidnon(Sumilao) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
